_comment: goarch.org/chapel readings with FULL citations, every civil date 2018-01-01..2027-12-31, harvested 2026-10-14 from the monthly grid view (calendar?month=M&year=Y&viewStyle=GridView&viewType=ViewReadings) via a real browser after Brian cleared the Cloudflare check. Format: date -> [GOA day label, [[type, citation], ...]] where type is the lectionary link's type parameter: E=Epistle, G=Gospel, MG=Matins Gospel, OT=Old Testament (Vespers). Citations are verbatim, including source typos (e.g. "Mark 13:31-37: 14:1-2"). Supersedes data/goa2026.txt, which kept only the opening chapter:verse and so could not detect pericope-boundary differences.
